description.ko: TruffleHog 시크릿 스캔 결과를 웹훅으로 수신·저장하고 스캔·심각도·검증 상태별 조회를 제공하는 에이전트입니다. 전용 화면이 없어 좌측 메뉴에는 표시되지 않으며, AI 어시스턴트를 통해 질의응답으로 사용합니다.
description.en: Agent that receives and stores TruffleHog secret-scan results via webhook and provides queries by scan, severity, and verification status. It has no dedicated screen and does not appear in the left menu — use it via Q&A through the AI Assistant.

description_en: Receives and stores TruffleHog secret-scanning results via webhook. Provides query endpoints for reviewing discovered secrets by scan, severity, and verification status. It has no dedicated screen and does not appear in the left menu — use it via Q&A through the AI Assistant.

endpoints.summary: Receive TruffleHog scan result (webhook, guarded by TRUFFLE_WEBHOOK_ENABLED)
List stored scan results with optional verified_only and limit filters
Retrieve a single scan result with full findings
Return store stats and last scan summary

env_vars.name: TRUFFLE_WEBHOOK_ENABLED
env_vars.description: Enable or disable the POST /scan-results webhook receiver

env_vars.name: TRUFFLE_SCAN_MAX
env_vars.description: Maximum number of scan results retained in the in-memory deque

notes: No persistent storage — results live in a bounded in-memory deque. Restart clears all data. Wire TruffleHog CI output to POST /truffle-scan/scan-results.
